stemMd: Some members of the choir are doctors. All doctors in the choir work at the hospital. Therefore some choir members work at the hospital. Which parallels this?

options.label: A
options.textMd: All novels are books. This is a book. Therefore this is a novel.

options.label: B
options.textMd: All atlases are books. Some books are illustrated. Therefore all atlases are illustrated.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Some books on this shelf are atlases. All atlases on this shelf are illustrated. Therefore some books on this shelf are illustrated.

options.label: D
options.textMd: No atlas is a novel. Some books are atlases. Therefore no book is a novel.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Some books are old. Some old objects are valuable. Therefore some books are valuable.

explanationMd: The original starts with an existing subset and applies a universal property to that subset. The atlas argument preserves the same particular-to-particular inference through a universal middle premise.

distractorRationale.e: The two particular subsets need not overlap.
distractorRationale.b: The particular overlap does not cover all atlases.
distractorRationale.d: The conclusion improperly generalizes an exclusion.
